Priya: quick note from today's chaos run: when the east control plane partially partitioned we ended up with overlapping write epochs for ~8 tenants. need a compact arbitration + residency-first fallback that doesn't require manual legal approval every time.
Diego: can you share the minimal repro?
Priya: steps: 1) split control plane (east loses leader election), 2) regional autoscaler in west increases capacity, 3) some tenants accept writes in both regions. logs: ```
[1743219999] cp-partition start regions=us-east-1,us-west-2
[1743220001] write tenant=acct-201 region=us-west-2 seq=102
[1743220002] write tenant=acct-201 region=us-east-1 seq=103
[1743220005] dual-write-detect tenant=acct-201 window_ms=6000
```
Marta: high-level rule: legal-resident tenants should prefer immutability-first (no cross-region write acceptance). non-resident tenants can use optimistic lease with faster failover. propose enum: residency_policy={locked, consented, flexible}.
Rajat: operational knobs: lease_ttl=25s, renew_threshold=0.6, forward_limit=8, quarantine_ttl=90s. Also: limit concurrent reconciles to 4 to avoid spike.
Diego: for conflict resolution: for idempotent ops rerun in primary; for non-idempotent we produce conflict records and surface a reconciliation API `POST /v1/reconcile/{tenant}` that applies owner-specified resolution strategy.
Priya: model-serving gotchas: both regions may load incompatible quantized model versions leading to inconsistent outputs after reconciliation. we should include a model-tag with each write epoch and block reconciliation until models are unified or a model-compatibility shim runs.
Marta: agree. add `model.tag` to lease metadata. also, policy: if `residency_policy=locked` then writes that can't be forwarded should return 409 immediately instead of being accepted.
safety-bot: :warning: dual-write threshold 3 crossed at 1743220005 for tenants [acct-201, acct-412]
Rajat: API additions: `/v1/tenants/{id}/arbitrate?action=pin|unpin|status`, `/v1/arbitration/forwards` bulk view. add telemetry `arb.forward.latency`, `arb.dualwrites.count`.
Diego: tests: network partition + model-quant-mismatch + KMS slowdown. ensure locked-residency tenants never get auto-forwarded in sim.
Priya: runbook snippet: ```
on dual-write alert:
1) check residency_policy for affected tenants
2) if locked -> immediately disable remote write acceptance and surface audit to legal
3) if consented -> attempt leader-acquire in primary; if fail -> forward writes for 30s with budget guard
4) run `POST /v1/reconcile/{tenant}` with resolution=owner_default when writes ok
```
Marta: add console UI: show `residency_policy`, last-arbitration-event, and a one-click `force-pin` with audit.
Rajat: budget guard: estimate forward_cost = model_cost_per_token * qps_window * estimated_duration; abort if > 15% region_budget.
Priya: OK i'll draft RFC follow-up with state-machine and API shapes and add the tests Diego requested. will ping for review.
Diego: :thumbsup: will review the reconciliation API.
